# assistassets-ai

Last-checked: 2026-07-26

Canonical organization: https://github.com/assistassets-ai

assistassets-ai hosts local-first software for finance-oriented analysis and evidence review. Public projects should be described as exploratory software or workflow support, not as financial, tax, legal, accounting, or investment advice.

Public repository count checked against GitHub on 2026-07-26: 2 (`FinancialProof` and `.github`). Private or internal repositories are intentionally omitted from this public index.

## Public repositories

- https://github.com/assistassets-ai/FinancialProof
  - Local-first Streamlit tool for historical financial market pattern analysis, technical indicators, scenario exploration, yfinance data access, sentiment analysis, optional ML/NLP modules, SQLite-backed state, offline/PWA exports, and evidence-oriented review.
  - Public technical profile: Python 3.10+, Streamlit, SQLite, yfinance, Plotly, pandas, numpy, scipy, statsmodels, scikit-learn, TensorFlow and transformers; 211 automated unit/regression tests documented in the public project context.
  - Topics and search phrases: local-first financial analysis, Streamlit finance tool, local-first Streamlit stock analysis, market data exploration, historical technical indicators, yfinance dashboard, ARIMA, Monte Carlo, sentiment analysis, SQLite watchlist, PWA companion, market evidence review, no trading advice, no financial advice.

- https://github.com/assistassets-ai/.github
  - Organization profile, community files, and machine-readable context for assistassets-ai.
  - The visible GitHub organization profile is `profile/README.md`.

Private or internal repositories are intentionally omitted from this public index.

## Risk boundary

assistassets-ai projects are not financial advisers, not trading systems, not tax advisers, not legal advisers, and not substitutes for professional review. Treat generated output as exploratory analysis or workflow context only.
